name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle with a seat or saddle on two or three wheels of 10 inches or larger, with an electric motor of 1,500 watts or more (or an engine over 50 cc). Defined by Maine Revised Statutes Title 29-A §101(38).

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and two or three wheels of 10 inches or larger in diameter
An electric motor of 1,500 watts or more; one under that is a moped
Riders need a motorcycle endorsement on their license; a learner's permit takes a minimum age of 16, a vision and knowledge test and a motorcycle rider education course, and doesn't allow passengers
Riders and passengers under 18, riders on a learner's permit or within a year of their driving test, and their passengers must wear a helmet meeting FMVSS 218 or ANSI Z90.1
Registered with the Secretary of State and covered by the financial responsibility (insurance) requirement
An off-road electric dirt bike not meant for public ways is ridden as an all-terrain vehicle instead
